# InputTest.online — llms.txt
# This file helps AI language models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Claude)
# understand the content and purpose of this website.
# Format: https://llmstxt.org/

> InputTest.online is a free, browser-based hardware input device testing platform.
> It allows users to test and diagnose computer peripherals — keyboard, mouse, gamepad,
> microphone, webcam, display, speakers, USB, and more — entirely in-browser with no
> downloads, no login, and no data transmitted to any server. All tests run 100% locally.

## About

- **Website**: https://inputtest.online/
- **Category**: Online Utility / Hardware Diagnostics / Tech Tool
- **Cost**: 100% Free
- **Privacy**: All tests run client-side. No data is collected or stored.
- **Platform**: Works on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS (browser-based)

## Main Tools

- [Keyboard Tester](https://inputtest.online/keyboard): Test all keyboard keys in real time. Detects stuck keys, ghosting, N-key rollover, and key chatter. Supports Windows and macOS layouts.
- [Mouse Tester](https://inputtest.online/mouse): Test all mouse buttons (left, right, middle, side), scroll wheel, double-click issues, and calculate CPS (clicks per second).
- [Scroll Wheel Jump Tester](https://inputtest.online/scroll-test): Accurately detect mouse scroll wheel jumping in the wrong direction, rotary encoder chatter, reverse-ticks, and calculate scroll health percentage.
- [Mouse Polling Rate Tester](https://inputtest.online/mouse-polling-rate): Measure mouse USB report rate in Hz (125Hz to 8000Hz), peak frequency, interval latency in milliseconds, and packet jitter variance online.
- [Mouse Angle Snapping & Jitter Tester](https://inputtest.online/mouse-angle-snapping-test): Detect hardware optical sensor angle snapping, cursor prediction, and raw input precision in browser.
- [Microphone Test](https://inputtest.online/mic): Live microphone test with real-time waveform, decibel meter, echo test, and noise analysis. Detects mic not working, distortion, and clipping.
- [Webcam Test](https://inputtest.online/webcam): Test webcam video feed, resolution, frame rate, and check if webcam is working in browser.
- [Gamepad Tester](https://inputtest.online/gamepad): Test PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo controllers. Detects analog stick drift, button mapping, trigger sensitivity, and vibration.
- [Controller Stick Circularity Test](https://inputtest.online/controller-circularity-test): Calculate gamepad analog stick circularity error percentage, Hall Effect magnetic sensor fidelity, resting stick drift, and cardinal deadzones online.
- [Display Tester](https://inputtest.online/display): Test monitor for dead pixels, backlight bleed, color accuracy, brightness uniformity, and response time.
- [Monitor Ghosting & UFO Tester](https://inputtest.online/monitor-ghosting-test): Benchmark pixel response time (GtG), inverse overdrive overshoot, motion blur, and VA black smearing at 60Hz, 144Hz, 240Hz, and 360Hz.
- [Sound Tester](https://inputtest.online/sound): Test speakers and headphones. Check left/right channel balance, frequency response, and bass.
- [Audio Frequency & Bass Tester](https://inputtest.online/audio-frequency-test): Test headphone bass rumble (10Hz–200Hz), hearing high-frequency limits (8kHz–20kHz), and generate pure audio tones using Web Audio API.
- [Latency Test](https://inputtest.online/latency): Measure input lag and system latency.
- [USB Tester](https://inputtest.online/usb): Detect connected USB devices and check USB port functionality.
- [USB-C Tester](https://inputtest.online/usb-c): Test USB-C port capabilities including power delivery and data speeds.
- [Biometric Tester](https://inputtest.online/biometric): Test fingerprint readers and biometric sensors.
- [Battery Test](https://inputtest.online/battery): Check laptop battery health, charge cycles, and capacity.
- [Printer Test](https://inputtest.online/printer): Test printer connectivity and print quality.
- [Scanner Test](https://inputtest.online/scanner): Test scanner device recognition.
- [VR Test](https://inputtest.online/vr): Test VR headset and controller inputs.
- [LAN Tester](https://inputtest.online/lan): Test local area network connection.
- [HDMI Tester](https://inputtest.online/hdmi): Test HDMI port and display output.
- [VGA Tester](https://inputtest.online/vga): Test VGA port connections.
- [System Specs](https://inputtest.online/specs): View complete hardware specs of your device.
- [Full Report](https://inputtest.online/report): Generate a complete hardware health report.
- [Desktop Software Suite](https://inputtest.online/software): Free lightweight portable Windows utilities for gamers and power users.
- [InputTest ClickShield™](https://inputtest.online/mouse-double-click-fixer): Free portable Windows utility to eliminate mouse double-clicking and switch debounce chatter in real time.
- [Headphone 3D Spatial Audio & Polarity Test](https://inputtest.online/headphone-test): Benchmark headphone 360° spatial positioning, HRTF soundstage azimuth, Left/Right channel isolation, and 180° acoustic phase cancellation in browser.
- [Mouse Acceleration & Raw Input Test](https://inputtest.online/mouse-acceleration-test): Detect positive/negative mouse acceleration, verify 1:1 raw input linear tracking, and measure DPI consistency using Pointer Lock API.
- [Microphone Gain Clipping & Noise Floor Meter](https://inputtest.online/mic-clipping-test): Real-time decibel (dBFS) VU meter to measure background ambient room noise floor, detect digital clipping distortion at 0 dBFS, and monitor live microphone loopback.
- [Monitor Black Level & Contrast Calibration](https://inputtest.online/monitor-black-level-test): Calibrate monitor black levels, detect shadow black crush (RGB 1-16), test white highlight clipping, check color banding, and verify Gamma 2.2 curves with interactive optical patterns.
- [Controller Trigger Deadzone & Throttle Test](https://inputtest.online/controller-trigger-test): Test gamepad LT/RT (L2/R2) analog triggers for stickiness, deadzones, hair-trigger microswitches, and verify 100% full throttle acceleration.
- [Keyboard Polling Rate & Scan Latency Test](https://inputtest.online/keyboard-polling-rate): Test keyboard USB report polling rates from 125Hz to 8000Hz and internal matrix scan latency with microsecond event timestamp tracking.
- [Bluetooth Audio Delay & Lip-Sync Test](https://inputtest.online/audio-latency-test): Measure wireless headphone latency in milliseconds (ms), calibrate audio-visual sync, and test gaming headset lag.
- [Monitor Micro-Stutter & Frame Pacing Jitter Test](https://inputtest.online/monitor-frame-pacing-test): Diagnose display hitching, measure frame time consistency in milliseconds, and detect dropped v-sync frames in real time across 60Hz to 360Hz.
- [Mouse Lift-Off Distance (LOD) & Sensor Cutoff Test](https://inputtest.online/mouse-lod-test): Test optical mouse sensor cutoff height, measure unwanted cursor jitter during mouse swipe resets, and verify sub-1mm esports LOD.
- [Monitor Size, PPI & Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://inputtest.online/monitor-ppi-calculator): Compare computer monitors side-by-side to true physical scale, calculate Pixels Per Inch (PPI), dot pitch, physical dimensions, and aspect ratio workspace differences.
- [Room Reverb & Echo RT60 Acoustics Tester](https://inputtest.online/room-acoustics-test): Analyze room echo reflections, measure acoustic decay time (RT60), and check vocal clarity for streaming and Discord.
- [Human Reaction Time & Reflex Benchmark](https://inputtest.online/reflex-reaction-test): Benchmark visual click speed against auditory sound reaction time with microsecond event timers and global percentile ranking.
- [InputTest Hardware Store](https://inputtest.online/store): Curated laboratory-tested mechanical keyboards, optical gaming mice, Hall Effect anti-drift controllers, webcams, and studio microphones with Amazon links.

## Mini Games & Speed Tests

- [CPS Test](https://inputtest.online/cps-test): Click per second test — measure how fast you can click.
- [Typing Test](https://inputtest.online/typing): Test your typing speed (WPM) and accuracy.
- [Reaction Test](https://inputtest.online/reaction): Measure your reaction time in milliseconds.
